# jans_admin_ui_webhook (Resource)

Resource for managing AdminUI webhooks.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name of the webhook.
- `url` (String) URL the webhook invokes.

### Optional

- `aui_feature_ids` (List of String) AdminUI feature ids this webhook is bound to.
- `description` (String) Description of the webhook.
- `http_headers` (Block List) HTTP headers sent when invoking the webhook. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--http_headers))
- `http_method` (String) HTTP method used when invoking the webhook.
- `http_request_body` (Map of String) Request body sent by the webhook, as key/value pairs.
- `http_request_body_string` (String) Request body sent by the webhook, as a raw string.
- `jans_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the webhook is enabled.

### Read-Only

- `base_dn` (String) Base DN of the webhook.
- `dn` (String) DN of the webhook.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `inum` (String) Unique identifier of the webhook.

<a id="nestedblock--http_headers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `http_headers`

Optional:

- `key` (String) Header name.
- `value` (String) Header value.
